newsitem.title: USA: US cash crudes deflate on technical paper selling.
newsitem.headline: US cash crudes deflate on technical paper selling.

text.p: U.S. cash crudes ended the week in a sharp downturn, retreating drastically on the back of technical selling in the paper markets and bearish products.

Spot NYMEX futures were under pressure throughout the session, notably in the final hour of trading, pushing the corresponding March West Texas Intermediate/Cushing cash price down nearly 90 cents to end at $22.15-25 a barrel.

Outright prices were not impacted by outside news, but were forced lower by a market keen to run technical "stops" to the downside. Forecasts for warm weather in the U.S. heating oil belt along the East Coast added to the crude flounder.
